semantic_rerank.selection_policy: Max-F1 ties prefer OOD rejection then recall; recall-constrained selection maximizes OOD rejection; OOD-constrained selection maximizes recall. Remaining ties prefer the smallest threshold.
semantic_rerank.limitations: Exploratory fit on the reported synthetic queries, not held-out calibration. Binary domain detection does not guarantee correct top-ranked standards. Production settings are not modified.
